title: Code-to-Docs Extraction
description: Parses docstrings and type hints into structured API references automatically. The extractor walks the AST, pulls signatures, types, and doc text, and emits reference pages. Docs stay in sync because they are generated from the code itself.
key_mechanisms: Walk the AST for public symbols

demo.title: Demo — Code-to-Docs Extraction

title: API Reference Synthesis
description: Generates endpoint documentation from OpenAPI specs with live runnable examples. Parameters, schemas, and error codes come from the spec; examples are executed against a sandbox to prove they work. The reference is never hand-written, so it never drifts.

demo.title: Demo — API Reference Synthesis

title: Diagram Generation
description: Renders Mermaid diagrams from code dependency graphs so architecture pictures update with the code. Import graphs become component diagrams; call graphs become sequence sketches. Stale architecture diagrams become impossible.

demo.title: Demo — Diagram Generation

title: Changelog Compilation
description: Builds changelogs from conventional commits grouped by type. Feat, fix, and breaking-change commits become structured release notes automatically. Teams get release notes for free by following the commit convention.

demo.title: Demo — Changelog Compilation

title: Docstring Enforcement
description: Adds CI gates that fail when public functions lack docstrings. The check runs on every pull request, so undocumented APIs cannot merge. Coverage trends are tracked like test coverage.

demo.title: Demo — Docstring Enforcement

title: Example Synthesis from Tests
description: Converts unit tests into runnable documentation examples. Tests already show correct usage; the synthesizer extracts them, cleans up scaffolding, and embeds them in docs. Examples are guaranteed correct because CI runs them.

demo.title: Demo — Example Synthesis from Tests

title: Architecture Decision Records
description: Templates ADRs capturing context, decision, and consequences for every significant choice. Future developers learn why the system looks the way it does instead of guessing. ADRs are stored with the code so they survive team changes.

demo.title: Demo — Architecture Decision Records

title: Onboarding Path Generation
description: Orders documentation into a learning path from setup to advanced topics. The generator analyzes doc dependencies — what must be read before what — and produces a sequenced curriculum. New hires follow one path instead of drowning in pages.

demo.title: Demo — Onboarding Path Generation

title: Glossary Extraction
description: Mines domain terms and definitions from the codebase and docs. Type names, enum values, and repeated phrases become glossary entries with usage examples. Newcomers get a shared vocabulary without asking around.

demo.title: Demo — Glossary Extraction

title: Tutorial Scaffolding
description: Generates step-by-step tutorial skeletons from feature specs. Each feature's spec becomes a tutorial outline with setup, steps, and verification checkpoints; authors fill in prose. It guarantees every feature ships with a tutorial.

demo.title: Demo — Tutorial Scaffolding

title: Doc Coverage Metrics
description: Measures documented-versus-undocumented API surface over time. Like test coverage, the metric makes documentation debt visible and trackable. Teams set coverage gates and watch the trend.
key_mechanisms: Count public symbols vs documented ones

demo.title: Demo — Doc Coverage Metrics

title: Stale-Doc Detection
description: Flags documentation that references renamed or removed symbols. The detector cross-references doc mentions against the current symbol table after every commit. Stale references are filed as issues automatically.

demo.title: Demo — Stale-Doc Detection

title: Multilingual Doc Sync
description: Tracks translation coverage and flags out-of-date translations when the source changes. Each translated page records the source revision it was translated from; when the source moves, the translation is marked stale. It keeps multilingual docs honest.
key_mechanisms: Mark stale when the source changes

demo.title: Demo — Multilingual Doc Sync

title: Search Index Building
description: Builds full-text search indexes over all documentation for instant lookup. Tokenization, stemming, and ranking turn a docs folder into a searchable knowledge base. Rebuilds run on every docs commit.

demo.title: Demo — Search Index Building

title: Docs-as-Code Pipelines
description: Versions documentation in git with CI builds, previews, and link checks. Docs get the same rigor as code: reviews, tests, and automated publishing. Broken links and build errors block the merge.

demo.title: Demo — Docs-as-Code Pipelines
